tested_scope: Constructed Bernoulli fixed traces for one role-local assignment switch test only. The result tests durable sequential decision-state behavior; it does not estimate real optimizer win probabilities or claim statistical validity outside the precommitted toy model.

public_sources.name: Wald, Sequential Tests of Statistical Hypotheses (1945)
public_sources.bound_semantics: The sequential probability ratio test accumulates likelihood evidence for two specified hypotheses and makes a stopping decision from sequential evidence rather than a fixed sample count.

public_sources.name: Fischer and Ramdas, Improving the approximate sequential probability ratio test by avoiding overshoot
public_sources.bound_semantics: The commonly used approximate SPRT thresholds are (1-beta)/alpha and beta/(1-alpha) in likelihood-ratio form; crossing upper/lower thresholds stops the test, while remaining between them continues sampling. The paper also warns these approximate thresholds do not in general guarantee exact alpha/beta error control because of overshoot.

source_binding_limit: Only sequential likelihood accumulation, two stopping boundaries, and a continue region are imported. The approximate boundaries are used solely as frozen deterministic thresholds for the constructed trace; no exact frequentist error guarantee is claimed.

accept_stream.decision: CONTINUE through observation 5; ACCEPT_B at observation 6

candidate_results.reason: Switching after the first favorable comparison ignores the precommitted continue region and transfers authority before the upper boundary is crossed.

candidate_results.trace: Unique same-scope terminal comparisons update a durable cumulative log-likelihood exactly once. The all-success trace remains CONTINUE through five observations and reaches ACCEPT_B only on the sixth; the mixed trace remains CONTINUE; four failures reach REJECT_B. A remains authoritative in CONTINUE/REJECT_B, and ACCEPT_B remains qualification-only until a separate durable promotion/pointer check.

candidate_results.reason: Recomputing from all visible observations without persistent identities permits duplicate counting after restart and violates G2-G4 and G10.
Delegating sequential testing and decision state to an external hosted experimentation/statistics service creates a residual execution/quota dependency.

accepted_claim: For the exact precommitted toy model and streams, durable sequential likelihood state provides an explicit no-decision continuation state, resists duplicate/restart double counting, and prevents authority switching before the upper evidence boundary is crossed.
not_claimed: No exact alpha/beta guarantee for the approximate thresholds, no real-world effect-size inference, no production experimentation claim, and no optimizer superiority claim.
exact_next_action_after_readback: Advance controller credit by one only after independent readback. Then precommit a distinct bounded-evidence confidence-sequence or e-value switching leaf before any public semantic read for that leaf, preserving the open-ended Phase-1 frontier.
